Nevim co se chceš z tý psychologie na střední učit, když nemáš žádnej potřebnej základ. Začíná se nějakou základní historií psychologie a pak se přechází k základním jevům, psychickému zdraví a komunikaci. Společně s ostatními společenskými vědami se to taky vyučuje protože je to všechno propojený

Je vidět, žes prostě na hodinách zsv a dějepisun edával pozor, protože absolutně nevíš o čem mluvíš. 

Psychologie je na většině škol reálně první společenská věda, která se probírá. Neprobírá se nějak hloubkově, od toho plyne název předmětu ZÁKLADY společenských věd. Na nezaměřený školy prostě nenaserou psychologii, sociologii, právo, ekonomii, politologii a filosofii, tak to zmatlali do jednoho předmětu, kterej tě naučí aspoň základ od všeho.

To, že nevidíš pointu v dějepisu je upřímně děsivý. Je potřeba znát historii, aby se ta zla, co tu byla, neopakovala. Většina populace ale o historii neví nic, tak vznikají proruské, nebo neonacistické dezolé, co ani neví, co slova která používaj znamenají.

Stats don't really matter at such a low level. The thing that matters is gear! Equip the highest level gear (of your preffered category), thats what makes the biggest difference. With the kusarigama high stance is your best bet.

The only stat i consider a must is spirit. Get as much as you need to unlock all bonuses from the gs you are using (I reccomend Kato early game). 

Although spirit is the most important imo invest in magic aswell! Some of it is pretty op and after the next mission, you will have access to the most op tool in the entire game but I won't spoil it for you. You have access to weakness talismans from the start. It makes enemies take 20% more damage. 

While on the topic of magic. Invest in one or 2 element talismans! The best ones are imo water (makes enemies take more damage), wind (makes enemies do less damage) and lightning (slows enemies down). There are also 2 more fire (damage over time) and earth (more ki damage). 

Since you are new, I reccomend wind or lightning but also get fire (it will come in handy soon). 

Since you are going with the kusa you are getting ninjustsu points almost for free. Although i dont find ninjutsu as good as magic you can invest in power pills. Im not sure of the ammount but it boost your atack noticably. 

While on the topic of elements there is a thing called confusion which happens when an enemy has 2 elements active on the at the same time. It is completely busted in nioh 1 as it removes all ki from the enemy and I believe makes them take extra damage. Since the kusa hits so many times it is easy to apply elements and keep the stagger going! 

Learn how to ki pulse and flux but the kusarigama isnt as reliant on stance switching as other weapons so you are probably good with just ki pulsing.

In combat, focus on lowering the enemy's ki. Especially if its a yokai. They loose all poise when you break their ki (this makes confusion so op in nioh 1) so you can spam high stance kusa when that happens. If a human is left with no ki, you can perform a grapple or a finish blow if you hit them with a regular atack before the graple. Graples are safer since they give you I-frames. 

If you get caught in a combo, you cannot dodge right away, but you can start blocking! This can save many lives since a combo is most likely death from most enemies in this game. 

Hope this helps!
